title: Heroes of Dragon Age Reborn
author: Jealous-Sound-3067
selftext:
Hi! I wanted to share my project, which I started working on back in July. Initially, I wanted to get back to the feeling of writing code myself. I like C and C-style C++ (C++ was the first programming language I learned, and I'm a big fan of Jonathan Blow, Casey Muratori, Mike Acton, etc.), so I decided to write everything in C. However, once I started dealing with the original game's shader code and model animations, I realized it was a little beyond what I could comfortably handle, especially since I have a job and other things to do 😅 I also wanted to avoid losing interest in a game I actually want to play or burning out during development.

So, after a while, I switched to ChatGPT. I used GPT 5.6 Sol Ultra back then and switched to Claude Opus 5 later on. Now, I mainly use Fable 5.2 Medium / Extra High for small changes, new features, balancing, and stuff like that. I also use GPT Image 2.6 to generate placeholder images for new content, since I'm not an artist. (Though, yeah, I could buy some art later on, idk.)

I don't use Ultracode because every time I've used it on previous projects, it's eaten through my usage limits without delivering the results I'd expect given how much of my allowance it uses and how long it takes to create a new feature or iterate on it.

What I focus on is how a feature looks and deciding what would be fun to implement next—basically, the creative part of the process. Although I used to love writing code and solving problems myself, enjoying the process more than the final product, I've now shifted my focus to coming up with fun ideas and mechanics. Over time, that's started to feel kinda just as fun to me 😅

This project is open-source and free, and it will stay free forever, since the costs of hosting and maintaining it are negligible anyway.

If you wanna try it out—or if you played the original game back when it was still around—here’s the project website: [https://hodareborn.com](https://hodareborn.com/)

replies.author: Jealous-Sound-3067
replies.body: It's a recreation of a dead game that you can play natively on macOS, Windows, and Linux without an Android emulator. Expeditions, daily / weekly quests, world chat is completely new content I added (with a new UI, placeholder images, etc.), though I'm trying to stay true to the game's original style.
